summary: Research-first AI agency OS core in zero-dependency Node.js: 11 ADRs, machine-readable contracts, and an acceptance run killed mid-task and resumed from disk with no side effect repeated.
key_features: Built research-first: 40 agent projects read with file:line evidence before a line was written
11 architecture decision records, 6 machine-readable contracts, 13 modules
Acceptance run is killed mid-task, reloaded from disk and resumed - then checked that no side effect repeated
The gate tests itself: a deliberate violation is planted in the tree and CI fails if the validator misses it
The contract validator is mutation-measured - remove any one of its 19 enforcement points and its self-test must fail (it once could not, for 8 of them)

social.headline: An agency OS whose strongest test is being killed mid-task and resumed.

provenance.rule: mechanical fields read from the repository and the GitHub API; editorial fields hand-written and reviewed; no field is generated from a guess
